audience: event organizers who run conferences and meetups in Eventee

useCases.title: Review the event program
useCases.text: The AI reads halls, days, sessions, workshops with capacity and bookings, breaks, speakers and labels, and spots gaps or clashes in the program.

useCases.title: See who registered and who has checked in
useCases.text: The AI lists participants with role, group, tickets and check-in time, and registrations with status (pending, confirmed, declined) and form answers.

useCases.title: Read session ratings and comments
useCases.text: The AI reads the 1 to 5 star ratings with comments and a summary per session, so you see which sessions were liked most.

useCases.title: Add a session and create its hall, speaker or label
useCases.text: The AI creates a hall, speaker or label, then adds a session that uses them to the program with a start time.

useCases.title: Invite or pre-register people for the event
useCases.text: The AI adds up to 100 people as attendees with a group and tickets, or pre-registers them. It sends emails only if you ask for that.

useCases.title: Check in an attendee or undo a check-in
useCases.text: The AI finds a participant and checks them in at the event, or undoes the check-in.
